properties.disease overview: A high-grade malignant bone-forming tumor, classically in adolescents, often arising in the metaphysis of long bones; presents with progressive pain and swelling and has early metastatic potential (especially to the lungs).
properties.mechanism: Malignant transformation of osteoblast-lineage cells producing osteoid; rapidly destructive lesion with aggressive periosteal reaction (e.g., Codman triangle, sunburst) and tendency for hematogenous spread.
